id.judul: Racun di Rantai Laut dan Sungai
id.instruksi: Ikuti rantai makanan. Bandingkan kadar pencemar yang bertahan di tubuh, atau perkirakan akibat bila satu makhluk hilang.
id.i-manusia: manusia yang sering makan ikan besar
id.i-banyakmangsa: metilmerkuri dari ikan teri bertahan di tubuh ikan tongkol
id.i-sekali: ia hanya makan satu kali seumur hidup
id.p-r1: Metilmerkuri berpindah melalui fitoplankton → udang kecil → ikan teri → ikan tongkol → hiu. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar metilmerkuri tertinggi?
id.p-r2: Metilmerkuri berpindah melalui fitoplankton → udang kecil → ikan teri → ikan tongkol → hiu. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar metilmerkuri terendah?
id.p-r3: Ikan tongkol memangsa ikan teri yang mengandung metilmerkuri. Mengapa kadar metilmerkuri pada tongkol cenderung lebih tinggi?
id.p-r4: DDT yang sulit terurai berpindah melalui kutu air → ikan mas → burung pecuk. Mana yang cenderung memiliki kadar DDT tertinggi?
id.p-r5: Di sungai, metilmerkuri berpindah melalui lumut → ikan kecil → ikan besar → manusia. Dalam contoh ini, siapa yang sering memakan ikan besar dan dapat terpapar metilmerkuri lewat makanannya?
id.p-r6: Di rantai lumut sungai → ikan kecil → ikan besar → manusia, metilmerkuri berpindah dari air ke kelompok pertama. Kelompok apa itu?
id.p-r7: Tikus memakan umpan beracun. Racun itu bertahan lama di tubuh tikus. Siapa yang berisiko terkena racun dengan memakan tikus-tikus itu?
id.p-r8: Di laut ini, ikan teri dimakan ikan tongkol. Bila nelayan menangkap hampir semua ikan tongkol, ikan teri kemungkinan…
id.p-r9: Bila fitoplankton banyak yang mati karena limbah, udang kecil yang memakannya kemungkinan…
id.p-r10: Di danau ini hanya ikan mas yang memakan kutu air. Bila ikan mas habis karena racun, kutu air kemungkinan…
id.p-r11: Di danau ini burung pecuk hanya memakan ikan mas. Bila ikan mas habis, burung pecuk kemungkinan…
id.p-r12: Hiu diburu sampai hampir habis. Ikan tongkol yang biasa dimangsa hiu kemungkinan…

en.judul: Poison in Sea and River Chains
en.instruksi: Follow the food chain. Compare concentrations of pollutants that stay in the body, or predict what happens when one living thing disappears.
en.i-manusia: people who often eat big fish
en.i-banyakmangsa: methylmercury from the anchovies stays in the tuna's body
en.i-sekali: it eats only once in its life
en.p-r1: Methylmercury moves through phytoplankton → small shrimp → anchovy → tuna → shark. Which tends to have the highest methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r2: Methylmercury moves through phytoplankton → small shrimp → anchovy → tuna → shark. Which tends to have the lowest methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r3: Tuna eat anchovies containing methylmercury. Why does tuna tend to have a higher methylmercury concentration?
en.p-r4: DDT breaks down slowly and moves through water flea → carp → cormorant. Which tends to have the highest DDT concentration?
en.p-r5: In a river, methylmercury moves through algae → small fish → large fish → people. In this example, who often eats large fish and can be exposed to methylmercury through its food?
en.p-r6: In river algae → small fish → large fish → people, methylmercury moves from the water to the first group. Which group is it?
en.p-r7: Field rats eat poisoned bait. The poison stays in their bodies for a long time. Who is at risk from eating those rats?
en.p-r8: In this sea, anchovies are eaten by tuna. If fishers catch almost all the tuna, the anchovies will probably…
en.p-r9: If much of the phytoplankton dies from waste, the small shrimp that eat it will probably…
en.p-r10: In this lake only carp eat water fleas. If the carp die out from poison, the water fleas will probably…
en.p-r11: In this lake cormorants eat only carp. If the carp die out, the cormorants will probably…
en.p-r12: Sharks are hunted until almost none are left. The tuna that sharks usually eat will probably…
